_comment: RLS Configurator settings. Reload the career (or restart) after changing anything. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_motorsport: Motorsport configs (Race/Rally/Drift/Drag) can be ordered but cost this extra surcharge on top.
_factoryLike: Config types / name fragments (matched in key or name) listed with the factory configs under Petrol/Diesel/Electric instead of Custom.
_shops: Brand factory stores are detected automatically on every map. Use these lists to add or exclude shop ids.
_engineSwap: Engine swap: "*" = all models, block single ones via engineSwapExcludedModels. Price = base config + value difference of the swapped parts (downgrades refund refundPct of the difference) + feePct conversion fee.
_engineSwapValue: Resale value of swapped cars = base value +/- part difference, without configurator surcharge and conversion fee, minus this discount in %.
_preferBaseExhaust: true = keep the base car's exhaust where both cars share the slots, otherwise use the donor exhaust incl. rear bumper/diffuser.
_debugDump: true = write diagnostic files (catalog, engines, last swap, order log) to the BeamNG user folder.

description.en: Straight off the line, direct delivery

_fulfilment: Default hand-over: "garage" (delivered to your garage, small fee) or "pickup" (free, collect it at the dealer's freight point).
